result.instructions: Tools for Oyster, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on the team, by country and department?"; "Which time off requests are waiting, and how many days does each person have left?"; "Show unreviewed expenses from this month and their totals.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Oyster data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run oyster_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run oyster_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run oyster_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. oyster_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: oyster_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: The connected Oyster company: id, name, registration number and corporate/billing addresses. GET /v1/company.

tools.name: oyster_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the company's team members (Oyster engagements: EOR employees, contractors, payroll team members) with name, role, type, state, country, start date, department and work email. Private details (date of birth, addresses, phones, salary, tax id) are left out; use oyster_get_team_member for one person. GET /v1/engagements.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_get_team_member
tools.title: Get team member
tools.description: One team member (engagement) with employment or contract details, department, benefits and terminations. Salary only with include_compensation; date of birth, addresses, phone numbers and citizenships only with include_personal_details. A contractor's tax id is never returned. GET /v1/engagements/{id}.

engagement_id.description: Engagement ID (from the matching list tool).

include_compensation.description: Also return the salary (employees). Default false.

include_personal_details.description: Also return date of birth, addresses, phone numbers and citizenships. Default false.

tools.name: oyster_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the company's departments with their description and number of team members. GET /v1/departments.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_list_time_off_requests
tools.title: List time off requests
tools.description: List time off requests with person, dates, type, state, reason and comments, optionally for some team members only. GET /v1/time_off/requests.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_get_time_off_request
tools.title: Get time off request
tools.description: One time off request with dates, day durations, hours, state, type, reason, comments and attachment. GET /v1/time_off/requests/{id}.

time_off_request_id.description: Time off request ID (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: oyster_list_time_off_balances
tools.title: List time off balances
tools.description: Time off entitlements per team member, in days: annual entitlement, accrued, carried over, adjusted, taken, available, upcoming and projected balance. GET /v1/time_off/entitlements.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_list_public_holidays
tools.title: List public holidays
tools.description: Public holidays between two dates (up to two years ahead) for a country (ISO code, optional subdivision) or for a team member's location. GET /v1/public_holidays.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. DE.

engagement_id.description: A team member's engagement ID: their location's holidays.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_list_expenses
tools.title: List expenses
tools.description: List team members' expenses with amount, category, dates, review state (UNREVIEWED, APPROVED, DECLINED) and receipt link. Search by name and filter by review state. GET /v1/expenses.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_get_expense
tools.title: Get expense
tools.description: One expense with amount, receipt amount, category, dates, review state, receipt link and team member. GET /v1/expenses/{id}.

expense_id.description: Expense ID (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: oyster_list_contract_changes
tools.title: List contract changes
tools.description: List contract change requests for all team members (position, compensation, bonus, allowance changes) with state, effective date, requester and the changes. GET /v1/contract_changes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_get_contract_change
tools.title: Get contract change
tools.description: One contract change with the requested changes, state, dates, team member and amendment documents. GET /v1/contract_changes/{id}.

contract_change_id.description: Contract change ID (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: oyster_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the company's Oyster invoices with type, status, payroll month, issue and due dates, amount, charge (payment) status and payout status. Filter by payroll period, issue date, type, status, charge status or team member. GET /v1/invoices.

charge_statuses.description: Only these charge (payment) statuses, e.g. OVERDUE.

types.description: Only these invoice types, e.g. PREFUNDING, SETTLEMENT, OYSTER_FEES, EXPENSES.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: One invoice by ID or reference code, with line items, tax, applied credit, charge, payout and document links. GET /v1/invoices/{identifier}.

tools.name: oyster_list_time_sheets
tools.title: List time sheets
tools.description: List time sheets with team member, period, cadence, status (PENDING_SUBMISSION, SUBMITTED, PENDING_APPROVAL, APPROVED) and worked/time-off totals. GET /v1/time_tracking/time_sheets.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (meta.pages is the page count).

tools.name: oyster_get_time_sheet
tools.title: Get time sheet
tools.description: One time sheet with totals, work summary, time off days and the daily entries. GET /v1/time_tracking/time_sheets/{id}.

time_sheet_id.description: Time sheet ID (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: oyster_approve_time_off_request
tools.title: Approve time off request
tools.description: WRITE: approve a pending time off request. Only on the user's explicit request; check the request with oyster_get_time_off_request first. Needs the manage scope. POST /v1/time_off/requests/{id}/approve.

time_off_request_id.description: Time off request ID (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: oyster_reject_time_off_request
tools.title: Reject time off request
tools.description: WRITE: reject a pending time off request with a reason the team member sees. Only on the user's explicit request. Needs the manage scope. POST /v1/time_off/requests/{id}/reject.

time_off_request_id.description: Time off request ID (from the matching list tool).

reason.description: Why the request is rejected (shown to the team member).

tools.name: oyster_approve_expense
tools.title: Approve expense
tools.description: WRITE: approve an unreviewed expense for reimbursement. Only on the user's explicit request; check it with oyster_get_expense first. Needs the manage scope. POST /v1/expenses/{id}/approve.

expense_id.description: Expense ID (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: oyster_decline_expense
tools.title: Decline expense
tools.description: WRITE: decline an unreviewed expense, optionally with a reason the team member sees. Only on the user's explicit request. Needs the manage scope. POST /v1/expenses/{id}/decline.

expense_id.description: Expense ID (from the matching list tool).

reason.description: Why the expense is declined (shown to the team member).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Oyster
prompts.description: What you can do with Oyster here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: look_up_the_team_and_its_departments
prompts.title: Look up the team and its departments
prompts.description: List the team members with their role, type and start date, and list the departments. Open one person for the employment details and benefits. Personal details stay out of the list.

prompts.name: review_the_time_off_requests_and_balances
prompts.title: Review the time off requests and balances
prompts.description: List the time off requests that wait for a decision. Check the remaining days of each person in the time off balances.

prompts.name: approve_or_reject_a_time_off_request
prompts.title: Approve or reject a time off request
prompts.description: Open a pending time off request to read its dates and reason. Then approve it, or reject it with a reason the team member sees.

prompts.name: review_and_decide_on_expenses
prompts.title: Review and decide on expenses
prompts.description: List the expenses that wait for review and open one to check its amount and receipt. Then approve it for reimbursement, or decline it with a reason the team member sees.

prompts.name: check_the_company_s_oyster_invoices
prompts.title: Check the company's Oyster invoices
prompts.description: Filter the company's Oyster invoices by status or charge status. Open one to see its line items, tax and document links.

prompts.name: find_time_sheets_that_wait_for_approval
prompts.title: Find time sheets that wait for approval
prompts.description: List the time sheets with their status to find those that wait for submission or approval. Open one to see the daily entries and time off days.
